name: Dating Naked UK
description: In the pursuit of love, 10 singles take the brave steps of stripping off before entering a daring, dating experience. Unclothed they must begin to get to know each other, before their connections are put at risk.

videos.title: Stripping Off
videos.overview: In the pursuit of love, 10 singles take the brave steps of stripping off and entering a daring, dating experience. Unclothed, start getting to know each other, before their connections are put to the test.

videos.title: The Naked Newbie
videos.overview: The first Naked Newbie wastes no time threatening connections. While some relationships grow, others' heads begin to turn, creating tensions before one dater is dumped for good.

videos.title: Dare or Bare
videos.overview: After the first dumping, daters are still seeking their connections. With some relationships severed, the way is paved for new ones to grow. A game of Dare or Bare leaves one dater with a regrets and time is running out for one of the girls.

videos.title: Cocktails & Cock Tales
videos.overview: Sparks fly as jealousy and competition build. And while one couple takes their connection to the next level, cast is doubt on another. Before a dramatic twist at the dumping ground.

videos.title: Kiss Kiss
videos.overview: After the shock of the dumping ground, two daters struggle to adjust to the change in the house. A fancy dress party delivers a special naked treat and too much tongue action pushes one pair to breaking point.

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: Another naked newbie arrives, creating the 'biggest test' for one couple. Meanwhile, those without strong connections are also feeling vulnerable.

videos.title: A Devlish Twist
videos.overview: There’s new competition for the girls, who are left fretting over whose feathers will be ruffled. Dom & Mike begin moving on from the past. And a heaven-sent party ends with a hellish surprise.

videos.title: Return Of The Exes
videos.overview: Two familiar faces are hell bent on reclaiming their connections, but will they be able to pick up where they left off? Daters indulge in a reverse strip tease, strengthening some, weakening others.

videos.title: Genuine Connections
videos.overview: As the experience nears the end, there are big decisions to be made that send shockwaves through the house.

videos.title: Winning Connections
videos.overview: The final 3 couples must prove they have the strongest connection, to be crowned Dating Naked winners. But with £50,000 on the line, will true colours emerge?

videos.title: Time To Bare All
videos.overview: Ten singles are ready to shed their inhibitions and their clothes, in their search for true love.

videos.title: It's Getting Hot in Here
videos.overview: The first naked newbie arrives, instantly threatening connections and causing chaos in the house.

videos.title: Dom's Back!
videos.overview: Two naked newbies arrive to shake things up and put connections to the test.

videos.title: One Big Sausage Party
videos.overview: A thrilling zipline date and a sizzling sausage party provide the backdrop for two more naked newbies to enter the house. Meanwhile, a love triangle is threatening to derail a strong female friendship.

videos.title: Save it with a Kiss
videos.overview: Naked Newbie Tilly arrives with a secret mission that shakes up the house dynamics and pushes some connections to breaking point.

videos.title: A Storm is Coming
videos.overview: A naked returner hopes to pursue an old flame, but is it too late? A saucy reverse strip tease gets one particular heart racing. And whilst romance blossoms, a storm is on the horizon in the form of another familiar face.

videos.title: Honey I'm Home
videos.overview: A determined naked returner seeks to reignite a pre-existing connection, creating a complicated love triangle. The drama doesn't stop there as tensions rise, and Radio Rylan intervenes with a twist like no other.

videos.title: A Beachy Decision
videos.overview: One dater leaves, and another returns to mixed reactions from the house. Connections are solidified, and a beach volleyball date serves up some fun before a dumping ground with a difference leaves one dater battling between their head and their heart

videos.title: The Ultimate Test
videos.overview: The Dumping Ground sees multiple casualties as the Daters head into this year's final stages. The remaining couples get their kit on whilst enjoying dates out of the house, before being confronted with an offer which could change everything.

videos.title: The Final Reveal
videos.overview: The Dating Naked UK experience comes to a close as one couple is crowned the winner. The final couples bare their souls in emotional love letters, but a shock dumping crushes one pair's chance at victory in a dramatic end to the naked journey.
